theorems.name: Submission.normalDefect_annulus_tendsto_closedBall
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (ρ : ℝ), Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ ↦ normalDefect V x (closedBall x ρ \ closedBall x σ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (normalDefect V x (closedBall x ρ)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
